tools.name: get_business_info
tools.description: Start here. What Arcana is, its hours, location, and contact links, every part of what it offers, and links to each.

tools.name: get_reservation_options
tools.description: Returns walk-in guidance and the public Resy reservation link.

tools.name: get_private_event_offer
tools.description: Returns Arcana qualitative private-event offerings and the inquiry form link.

tools.name: list_upcoming_events
tools.description: Returns upcoming public events at Arcana as published on Resident Advisor and Luma, with a link to each listing. The list refreshes once a day, so the listing is the authority for tickets and changes.

tools.name: prepare_inquiry
tools.description: Prepares a prefilled link for a private-event inquiry from whatever details are known. The person reviews the form and submits it.

tools.name: submit_inquiry
tools.description: Sends a private-event inquiry to the Arcana booking team. Use only after the person has seen these details and asked you to send them. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_upcoming_events · Private data: get_business_info, get_private_event_offer, prepare_inquiry, submit_inquiry · Public sink: submit_inquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_upcoming_events · Private data: get_business_info, get_private_event_offer, prepare_inquiry, submit_inquiry · Public sink: submit_inquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
